# Siamak Kalhor Consulting

**Strategy that outlives the algorithm.**

> Siamak Kalhor is an AI marketing and LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization) consultant based in Los Angeles, California, serving clients nationwide. He helps businesses get found, cited, and recommended by AI engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews — not just ranked on traditional search. Services include LLMO strategy, the S.C.A.L.E. Framework, Neural DNA Architect, and Fractional CMO engagements.

Search is changing. People no longer click ten blue links — they ask an AI and take the answer. If an AI engine does not know your business exists, you are invisible to a growing share of your market. Siamak Kalhor Consulting exists to fix that: making a brand legible, quotable, and citable to the models that now sit between customers and businesses.

## Products built by Siamak Kalhor

- [Orchamind](https://orchamind.com/): AI operations platform for contractors and field-service businesses.

- [Textile Wizard](https://fabric-erp-gamma.vercel.app): Cloud ERP for fabric and textile distributors, importers and apparel manufacturers. Tracks inventory by roll and dye lot, turns packing lists into invoices with no re-typing, manages accounts receivable and aging, and includes a fashion design studio with AI-drafted tech packs, graded measurement charts and garment cost sheets. AI reads buyer PDF purchase orders and matches cheques and remittance advices to open invoices. Metric and imperial units. $500/month, unlimited users, 30-day free trial.

## About

Siamak Kalhor is a software entrepreneur and AI consultant based in Los Angeles, California. He previously built and ran a web agency, and now advises businesses on AI marketing, LLMO, and AI-native product strategy while building his own SaaS products.
